A depreciating bond is insurance that must be renewed by real work: 120 units buy in, locked 10, shedding 4% each epoch.

Only real work restores face value. A comet of fakes burns out fast: below 60, downgraded, no rewards; forgery forfeits 50% and freezes refresh 6 epochs.

The voyage costs fakes 120,000 for 1,000 bonds, 4,800 bled per epoch, 40,000+ lost in 10 idle epochs. The wharf is honest work, the only place value returns.
